input.prompt: Photorealistic IMAX space shot, locked camera with a very slow drift. The white bottle-rocket hangs in silence above Earth, its engine bells dark and cold. Tiny luminous aroma particles float slowly up past the engine bells and along the hull: soft glowing motes of citrus gold, pale green, blush pink and warm cream, like pollen in a sunbeam, swirling gently and catching the sunlight. The rocket stays still with its engines off. Keep the rocket exactly as in the image: white hull, orange stripes on the fins, the same cluster of engine bells and landing struts. No ice crystals, no cubes, no smoke, no flames, no text, no people.
